title: What does idempotent actually promise?
origin: The card defines the word, and the confusion starts where it seems to stop applying

points.body: Repeating the call leaves the system as one call would. The response may differ, as a repeated DELETE returning 404 does.
When a reply is lost you cannot tell whether the work happened. Idempotence makes sending it again safe.
A POST is not idempotent by nature, but a client-supplied key lets the server recognize a repeat.

anchor.note: Press it ten times and one elevator still comes; the light just stays on.

card.a: An operation is idempotent if performing it **many times** has the same effect as performing it **once**.

breaks: Safe is not idempotent: reads change nothing
A repeat that fires a second email
